[Vers 1: Tobias Rahim]
Jeg' i Jylland, brænder Cali-weed
Min' tanker kører om en evergreen (Uh-ah)
Vi teamer op om godt halvanden time
På Grønnegade med et dollargrin (Uh-ah)

[Bro: Tobias Rahim]
Du siger, du ruller op, hvis jeg rister
Imens morgenerne bli'r til nætter
Alle er blå – blå silhuetter
Jeg vil bar' gå endnu længere med dig

[Omkvæd: andreas odbjerg]
Driver langs åen, jeg ser månen bli'r blokeret af dig
Ned' på Den Sidstе er vi de første til at gå vorеs vej
Ta'r dig ind, ta'r dig nu, ta'r dig sommeren ud
Her, jeg gi'r dig mit hjerte i Aarhus
Har aldrig danset med en stor mand
En stor mand som dig

inputs.text: style of Bruno Mars - That’s What I like

[Title: Slowing It Down]
[Style: Smooth R&B / Funk | Tempo: 95 BPM | Key: C Major]

[Intro]
[Warm Rhodes piano chords establish a lazy, groovy harmony. A deep, round bass line enters immediately with a smooth walking pattern. A crisp, dry snare hits on the backbeat (2 and 4). No orchestral pads; keep it tight and funky.]
(Ad-libs)
Yeah...
Slowing it down...
Mmm...

[Verse 1 - Male Vocal]
[Instrumentation: Sparse but rhythmic. Rhodes piano plays syncopated chords. Bass is prominent and melodic. Light finger snaps or hi-hat ticks on the off-beats.]
[Vocal: Low, intimate, close-mic. Smooth, conversational tone. No vibrato yet; keep it cool and laid-back.]
The clock on the wall is a liar tonight
Spinning too fast while we chase the light
I’m holding your hand like a lifeline in June
The only thing quiet in a world out of tune

[Pre-Chorus 1 - Male Vocal]
[Instrumentation: Muted trumpet or saxophone adds subtle stabs on the downbeats. Bass line gets slightly more aggressive.]
[Vocal: Slightly more confident, leaning into the groove. Still smooth, but with a bit more push.]
(softly) Every second feels like it's caught on hold
A story written that refuses to grow old

[Chorus 1 - Male Vocal]
[Instrumentation: Full band burst. Punchy kick drum and snare backbeat. Slap bass or round funk bass locks in tight with the drums. Muted horn section (trumpet/trombone) plays short, punchy stabs on beats 2 and 4.]
[Vocal: Confident, smooth, and rhythmic. Not "euphoric" or shouting; instead, it’s a cool, assured delivery with slight melisma on the last words. Layered background vocals sing "Grace."]
I’m slowing it down for the one that I love
Like the earth’s standing still while the stars crash above
It’s a beautiful weight, it’s a terrifying grace
I’m finally home in the light of your grace!
(In your grace)

[Verse 2 - Male Vocal]
[Instrumentation: Drums settle into a tight funk groove. Bass guitar locks in with rhythmic precision. Rhodes piano plays lighter, more percussive chords.]
[Vocal: Confident, grounded delivery. Slightly more rhythmic phrasing to match the tighter drum groove.]
We used to be shadows just passing through doors
But I’m not a ghost on these hardwood floors
Every bridge that I burned was a lesson I learned
To wait for the peace that I’ve finally earned

[Pre-Chorus 2 - Male Vocal]
[Instrumentation: Percussion layer (congas or shaker) enters lightly to add texture. Horns hold longer notes.]
[Vocal: Building momentum, slightly more forceful than Verse 1, but still smooth and controlled.]
(rising pitch) Every rush and every hurried pace is through
A quiet kind of magic I finally found in you

[Chorus 2 - Male Vocal]
[Instrumentation: Anthemic energy. Horn section accents the downbeats with muted brass hits. Bass line becomes more melodic and prominent.]
[Vocal: Triumphant but cool. Layered background vocals sing "Grace."]
Oh, I’m slowing it down for the one that I love!
Like the earth’s standing still while the stars crash above!
It’s a beautiful weight, it’s a terrifying grace
I’m finally home in the light of your grace!
(In your grace)

[Bridge - Male Vocal]
[Instrumentation: Drums drop slightly to allow space. Piano becomes more intricate and percussive (staccato hits). Bass holds longer notes.]
[Vocal: Intense, emotive delivery, leaning into texture. Slightly higher pitch but still smooth. Think "soulful" rather than "operatic."]
Don't let the sun rise, don't let it go cold
I’ve found a story that never gets old
The seconds are dripping like honey and wine
I’m finally yours, and I’m glad that you’re mine

[Instrumental Build-Up - Vocal Adlibs/Vamping]
[Drum fill accelerates rapidly. Horns build to maximum dynamic level (Fortissimo) with long, swelling notes.]
(Ad-libs)
Ohhh... yeah...
Slowing it down...

[Chorus 3 - Male Vocal]
[Instrumentation: Maximum intensity. Full drum kit, heavy kick and snare. Synth layers widen the soundscape but stay funky (no orchestral washes). Horns play full, open chords.]
[Vocal: Apex / Climax. Powerful but still smooth and controlled. Layered background vocals sing "Love."]
Oh, I’m slowing it down for the one that I love!
Like the earth’s standing still while the stars crash above!
It’s a beautiful weight, it’s a terrifying grace
I’m finally home in the light of your grace!
(In your grace)

[OUTRO]
[Reverb tail fade out. Long decay on the final Rhodes piano chord. Bass line fades slowly with a smooth slide.]
(Softly)
Slowing it down...
For the one I love... (fading)
(Ad-libs)
Yeah... that’s how it feels...
Mmm...

[End]
